problem: After entitlement repair, the owner completed a real challenge and tapped '生成我的世界模型报告'. The model call SUCCEEDED (ai_logs model_call status=SUCCESS, deepseek-chat, 2755ms) but the report entity was never advanced: ai_reports._id=ARCF9bc1766a2b0fbbcdfc0cdc3f stayed status='generating', content=null, updatedAt===createdAt, and no completion audit row was written. Root cause is structural: the post-model path (parseAiReport + completion conditional update + audit) was OUTSIDE any try/catch, parseAiReport was not tolerant, and the AI axios timeout (60s) equalled the cloud-function timeout (60s), leaving zero budget for the completion write. Result: a paid user can be left with a permanently stuck generating report and a client '生成超时' screen.

changes.DURABILITY: cloudfunctions/generateAiReport/lib/challengeReportIdempotency.js — everything after a successful model response is now protected: model ok → tolerant parse → validate → persist content → status ready → completion audit. Any recoverable failure (bad/non-object body, model timeout, persistence exception) is persisted as an explicit retryable terminal state on the SAME deterministic entity (status='failed' + lastError + parseFailed/persistFailed flag) — the entity can NEVER remain permanently status='generating', content=null. A later retry/re-entry reclaims it (failed-retry path) or takes it over once stale (existing stale-takeover CAS).
changes.PARSE_TOLERANCE: parseAiReport now coerces input to a string (object/null/undefined/number safe → .replace can never throw) and returns {ok:true,value} | {ok:false,error,raw}. Behaviour change vs Stage5C: an unparseable body is an explicit RETRYABLE FAILURE (status='failed', user '请重试') instead of fabricated placeholder content. Valid JSON → ready, unchanged.
changes.MODEL_BOUND: callAI is now bounded by MODEL_TIMEOUT_MS=90s via a withTimeout race (deps.modelTimeoutMs overridable in tests). Strictly below the 120s function timeout, reserving >=30s for parse+persist+audit. Timeout → explicit failed state (never stuck generating).
changes.PERSIST_FAILURE: The completion conditional update is wrapped; a persistence exception is audited (ai_logs action='generate_report' success=false) and ends in an explicit failed state; a completion success emits an audit row (action='generate_report' success=true).
changes.TIMEOUT_CONFIG: cloudbaserc.json generateAiReport timeout 60→120 (runtime untouched: Nodejs18.15 declared, live Nodejs16.13). Live function config pushed via `tcb config update fn generateAiReport --timeout 120`.
changes.ISPAID: Generation STILL never writes ai_reports.isPaid on ANY path (parse-fail / timeout / persistence-fail asserted).
changes.TESTS: tests/rc8.9/challenge-report-idempotency.test.js — added R4 matrix (R4-1..R4-7 + R4-12): success→ready+content; irregular body→explicit failed→retry recovers; model timeout→failed; parse never throws (5 input types); persistence exception→audited+terminal; stale generating→recovered; duplicate retry→one entity/same reportId; isPaid never written on any path. Suite 92 assertions (was 56). In-memory DB gained a failUpdateWhen fault injector.
